edges.reason: numberOfTokens parameter is consumed by mintNFT loop and range checks.
msg.sender determines balanceOf wallet cap and is the mint recipient.
saleIsActive boolean gates execution of mintNFT.
MAX_NFTS constant caps total supply in mintNFT.
NFTPrice multiplied by token count for the msg.value payment check.
mintNFT invokes _safeMint inside its minting loop.
_safeMint triggers onERC721Received on the msg.sender contract before supply state settles.
numberOfTokens controls how many times the safe mint operation executes.
_toPremint parameter is consumed by premint loop and range checks.
msg.sender is validated by the onlyPreminter modifier and is the mint recipient.
premint invokes _safeMint inside its minting loop.
_safeMint triggers onERC721Received on the msg.sender contract during premint.
premintReserve is read and bounded by the premint quantity checks.
premintReserve is decremented by SafeMath.sub at the end of premint.
premintIsActive boolean gates execution of premint.
PREMINT_SUPPLY constant caps supply during premint.
maxPremintPurchase constant limits per-wallet premint amount.
NFTPrice multiplied by premint count for the msg.value payment check.
preminters role mapping is queried by the onlyPreminter modifier of premint.
withdraw executes the ETH transfer unsafe operation.
transfer sends ETH to msg.sender, executing recipient code.
balance local variable supplies the transferred amount.
withdrawPartial executes the ETH transfer unsafe operation.
transfer sends ETH to the _recipient address, executing recipient code.
_amount parameter is the value transferred in withdrawPartial.
